title: Fix the shipping weight boundary
issue: The shipping table says a parcel of 5kg or more costs 12, but `shippingCost` uses a strict greater-than comparison, so a parcel of exactly 5kg is charged the light rate. Fix the boundary. Weights remain non-negative finite numbers and anything else must still raise a TypeError.
expectedBehavior: shippingCost charges 12 for every weight of 5kg and above and 5 below it, and still raises TypeError for negative, non-finite and non-numeric weights.
